# moq_recording_rule (Resource)

Records broadcasts whose paths match its patterns, into managed storage or your own S3-compatible bucket.

~> Destroying or replacing a rule deletes its recordings. Changing `patterns`, `label`, or the bucket's endpoint, credentials, or destination replaces the rule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Managed storage, kept for 30 days.
resource "moq_recording_rule" "live" {
  project_id     = moq_project.example.id
  patterns       = ["live/*.hang"]
  retention_days = 30
}

# Your own S3-compatible bucket, which owns retention.
resource "moq_recording_rule" "archive" {
  project_id = moq_project.example.id
  patterns   = ["archive/**/*.hang"]

  bucket = {
    endpoint          = "https://s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com"
    region            = "us-east-1"
    bucket            = "example-recordings"
    access_key_id     = var.recording_access_key_id
    secret_access_key = var.recording_secret_access_key
    delivery          = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `patterns` (Set of String) Broadcast path patterns relative to the project, 1 to 32. Each must match only Hang broadcasts, whose paths end in `.hang`, such as `live/*.hang` or `live/**/*.hang`.
- `project_id` (String) The project's immutable ID.

### Optional

- `bucket` (Attributes) Record into your own S3-compatible bucket instead of managed storage. Adding or removing it replaces the rule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bucket))
- `label` (String) Display label, at most 80 characters.
- `retention_days` (Number) Managed storage retention in days: 1, 7, 30, 90, 180, or 365. More than 7 needs a payment method. Your own bucket's lifecycle rules govern its retention.
- `vod_enabled` (Boolean) Whether matching broadcasts are recorded. Re-enabling resumes a rule stopped by a bucket refusal.

### Read-Only

- `bucket_id` (String) The customer bucket's ID, or null for managed storage.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time, RFC 3339.
- `id` (String) Rule ID.
- `upload_refusal` (String) Why the bucket refused an upload, which stopped recording until the rule is re-enabled; null while recording.

<a id="nestedatt--bucket"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bucket`

Required:

- `access_key_id` (String, Sensitive) Access key ID with write access, and read access for `delivery`. Write-only: the API never returns it.
- `bucket` (String) Bucket name.
- `endpoint` (String) S3-compatible endpoint, an https URL on a public host.
- `region` (String) Region used for signing.
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) Secret access key. Write-only: the API encrypts it at rest and never returns it.

Optional:

- `delivery` (Boolean) Serve playback from the bucket, which needs read access too.
- `destination` (String) Object prefix inside the bucket. Defaults to the bucket root.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by project ID and rule ID. Bucket credentials are write-only: the
# next apply records them from configuration without replacing the rule.
terraform import moq_recording_rule.live p123example/r123example
```
